messages:
noah: Heads-up 1 Arcadia procurement uploaded a SIG/CAIQ and asked two non-negotiables: 1) EU-only storage for EU tenants, 2) BYOK (customer-managed KMS keys). They want vendor approval by Wed AM. Can security intake?
sec_bot: Intake created: INT-ARCADIA-2026-11 — priority=high, assigned to security triage. SLA 48h.
rachel: Thanks @noah. Can you confirm which product surfaces the POC will use (embeddings + vector DB + chat)? Also attach the SIG/CAIQ files to the intake if not already.
devon: POC will exercise embeddings + reranking + batch ingest. Uploaded SIG and CAIQ to the secure portal. Link: https://files.redwood/customers/arcadia/sig
mira: Quick notes: BYOK for object storage + embeddings supported via SSE-KMS. Vector cache might use ephemeral keys; we'll need to document that. EU-only tenancy means dedicated EU-hosted deployment or Private.
legal_bot: Legal: If they insist BYOK with keys in their account, we need to check the contract for key-escrow and export clauses. Also GDPR addendum may be required for cross-border flow.
rachel: Triage plan: 1) Answer CAIQ top-15 risk items within 24h. 2) Produce 1-page security summary for procurement. 3) Confirm BYOK architecture and example key policy. Owners: mira (infra), devon (KMS), rachel (security summary).
devon: Sample minimal IAM snippet for cross-account decrypt:```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::444444444444:role/Redwood-KMS-Access"},
    "Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
    "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111111111111:key/arcadia-cmk"
  }]
}```
mira: Notes to include in CAIQ answers: - Audit logs: all KMS calls logged and visible via CloudTrail / shared logging bucket - Data partitioning: separate buckets + tenant-scoped prefixes + RBAC - No keys exported from customer account.
finance: FYI pricing: EU-dedicated instance = +16% list price; Private (on-prem) significantly higher. Will provide a quick delta doc in 12h.
rachel: Can someone upload SOC2 + pen test redactions to the intake? We prefer to send redacted copies to procurement portal.
devon: SOC2 uploaded (redacted) to secure intake.
noah: Arcadia asked if we can provide attestation that keys remain in their account and show usage logs. Is that supported?
mira: We can provide key ARN and CloudTrail sample logs showing kms:GenerateDataKey usage (with request IDs) and role assumption evidence. We'll redact timestamps sensitive to their ops.
legal_bot: Also confirm whether cross-account role requires a dedicated AWS account or can be a role in their existing account. Both are supported; document the recommended key policy.
rachel: Update 1745124200: CAIQ top-15 answered and uploaded. BYOK pattern documented with key-policy template and CloudTrail sample. 1-page security summary uploaded as well.
noah: Customer replied: they want a brief confirmation that vector embeddings storage can be encrypted with their CMK and that we won't hold key material. They need this in the procurement note.
devon: Confirmed: embeddings S3 bucket with SSE-KMS using their CMK in EU region. We will never export the key. Example storage config and IAM snippet in the intake.
finance: Uploaded pricing delta sheet: EU-only dedicated = +16% list, optional cross-region replication costs if they ask for global failover.
sec_bot: INT-ARCADIA-2026-11 status updated: triage -> in_progress at 1745124000 by rachel
noah: Appreciate the quick turnaround. If we can get the 1-pager + CAIQ answers by Tue EOD we'll be in good shape for procurement.
rachel: Final note: if Arcadia later requests HSM-backed keys we need additional onboarding steps (longer lead time). I've added that to the intake notes. Marking this intake resolved pending any follow-ups.
sec_bot: INT-ARCADIA-2026-11 status updated: in_progress -> resolved_by_rachel at 1745125400
noah: Thanks everyone 1 moving to follow-up for POC infra once procurement signs off.
